title: Sick but went to mallworld
content: I’m sick and just woke up from a nap. No medications and it’s my fifth day of being sick so not any crazy fever dream. I ended up having my own house which looked like the top floor of the dollhouse i usually see (one big open space) was taking care of this couple’s dog and had a bath size litter box for it (so random lol ??) . The girl and her boyfriend were graduating from UMiami later on in the day. Anyone? This is prob just a one off random dream hahaha
